chapter_title: The Theft of the Rimet Cup
title: The Puppy's Choice
subtitle: Which way should we go at the crossroads, left or right? Which side do you call, heads or tails?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof .... woof …

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof woof!
He places the cup next to Charlton and then runs towards a quiet corner.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Ahh! Puppy ran away. What's he gonna do?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: *coughs* Feeling sick. Disgusting. Almost crying.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Sor-Sorry, Ms. Acey. It was me who asked you to swallow too much weird stuff, ugh, even including me.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I swear, when it's all over, I will take you to a professional leather care store for proper treatment!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: But now, we have to get out of here as soon as possible.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Are you finished?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Of course. Iverson looks as if he's just swallowed a whole slug slime. Eventually, he's lost to the arcanist's imagination.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Those journalists who are not in the plan would definitely not miss the big news.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's all a mess here, and we are going to leave with ease now—

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Unnoticed.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Wooooof!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Hmm? What's coming?

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: Our kind of creature.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: I can't believe someone has found me. Am I exposed?

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof woof …

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Shh ... Wait, wait! Stop barking. Let's not get the others' attention!

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof woof!
Pickles lowers his voice and keeps saying something.

items.speaker: Ms. Acey
items.text: An anxious but friendly puppy.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Huuhh, all right, puppy. Let's make a deal.

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy wants to get rid of the current situation.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You wanna get out of here?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It's not part of the plan, but I can take you for a ride.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof woof …

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof!

items.speaker: "Doggie"
items.text: The puppy is asking for your opinion.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: What do you want?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: This? The pigment to make you invisible in a second. No one will see you, including your puppy friends.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Or, this? Breeze Glider. When you open your arms, or, um, your front legs, all it takes is a little breeze, and the flying membrane will get you anywhere.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Wooooof.

items.speaker: Pickles
items.text: Woof …

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Or, say, are you going to give everyone a surprise, too?

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Shock Alarm. It will wake up all the sleepyheads, keeping everyone wide awake. Ummm, it's often used to deal with those heavy-headed security guards.
The approaching footsteps interrupt their "communication."

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: Where is that puppy? I think it just came this way.

items.speaker: Passerby
items.text: A dog retrieved the cup! Mind-blowing news! He will be the star!

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: It sounds weird.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: You have to make your choice, smart puppy.
Those weird tools are displayed in front of Pickles. This is definitely an exceptional decision.

items.speaker: Melania
items.text: Cheers, pup.
With the noisy ring in the hall, the story of a hero puppy eventually catches everyone's attention.
TO BE CONTINUED ...
